prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web application screen, exactly 1536 × 960 landscape
Primary request: Create a production-credible Reviews screen for ASC Studio, a desktop App Store operations product. This is a brand-new mockup, not an edit. Match the established ASC Studio light-mode shell precisely: a fixed 276px left sidebar, 121px topbar, pale #f7f8fa canvas, white surfaces, flat 1px hairline panels, restrained spacing, readable Inter-like sans-serif typography, and simple Lucide-like outline icons.

Shell and navigation:
- Left sidebar is exactly 276px wide with the ASC Studio mark/title at top.
- App selector reads "Orbit Notes" and "com.example.orbitnotes".
- Sidebar items in order: "Overview", "TestFlight", "Releases", "Apple Ads", "Store Listing", "Monetization", "Distribution", "Reviews", "Activity".
- "Reviews" is the active item, using a pale blue selection fill and blue icon/text.
- Footer reads "Apple services" with a green dot and "Demo".
- Topbar is exactly 121px high. Large page title reads "Reviews". Subtitle reads verbatim: "Customer feedback and developer responses for Orbit Notes."
- The only topbar action is a modest secondary outlined button labeled "Refresh" with a refresh icon.
- Directly below the topbar, include a thin amber demo banner reading "Demo mode" and "Actions only change isolated sample data."

Main content:
Build a factual Response Status Board, not an analytics dashboard. Use three adjacent working panes inside the remaining content area:
1. Left, widest queue titled "Needs response" with a small neutral "Demo" badge.
2. Middle queue titled "Responded" with a small neutral "Demo" badge.
3. Right fixed 390px selected-review detail and response pane with a small neutral "Demo" badge.
The left queue must be visibly wider than the Responded queue. Separate panes with #dfe3e8 hairlines. Do not show queue totals.

Each queue contains dense but comfortably readable review rows, separated by hairlines. Each row includes:
- 1–5 star rating using blue filled stars and neutral unfilled stars
- concise review title and one-line excerpt
- territory code from only USA, GBR, or JPN
- a plausible calendar date
- response state, either amber "Needs response" or green "Responded"
Use small restrained badges only where useful. The selected row in "Needs response" has a pale blue background and blue left accent.

Use these exact sample row texts where legible:
Needs response:
- 2 stars, "Sync stalls after editing", excerpt "Changes stop appearing on my Mac until I reopen the app.", USA, Aug 19, 2026, Needs response
- 4 stars, "Almost perfect for class notes", excerpt "Fast and focused, but I would love better PDF handling.", GBR, Aug 18, 2026, Needs response
- 1 star, "共有ノートが更新されない", excerpt "編集後に同期されないことがあります。", JPN, Aug 16, 2026, Needs response
- 5 stars, "Export made my week", excerpt "Clean Markdown export and no formatting surprises.", USA, Aug 14, 2026, Needs response
Responded:
- 5 stars, "Exactly the notes app I needed", excerpt "Quick capture feels effortless.", GBR, Aug 17, 2026, Responded
- 3 stars, "Good, with one rough edge", excerpt "Search is useful but misses older attachments.", USA, Aug 15, 2026, Responded
- 4 stars, "シンプルで使いやすい", excerpt "毎日のメモにちょうどいいです。", JPN, Aug 12, 2026, Responded

Selected-review right pane:
- Header "Review details"
- Show full 2-star blue/neutral star rating and title "Sync stalls after editing"
- Full review body: "Changes stop appearing on my Mac until I reopen the app. I can see them on my phone, so the notes are safe, but the delay is confusing."
- Reviewer: "River K."
- Territory: "USA"
- Date: "Aug 19, 2026"
- Response state: amber "Needs response"
- Below a divider, a response composer headed "Respond to review"
- Textarea label must read verbatim "Review response"
- Textarea placeholder: "Write a concise, helpful response…"
- Small helper copy: "Responses are public after App Store review."
- Bottom actions: a quiet secondary "Cancel" button and a blue primary "Submit response" button.
Keep the composer practical, with generous writing space and no fake AI controls.

Visual system:
- Background #f7f8fa
- Panels #ffffff
- Primary text #15171b
- Secondary text #656b76
- Borders #dfe3e8
- Accent blue #1464e8
- Success green #42a348
- Warning amber #e69512
- No other prominent colors.
- Large page title around 34px; panel titles 17px; body and review titles 13–14px; metadata no smaller than 11px. All text must remain clearly readable at the full 1536×960 view.
- Use compact flat controls, square-ish 8–10px radii, 1px borders, no drop shadows.
- Preserve strong alignment, generous whitespace, and tabular dates/territory metadata.

Text requirements: render the specified shell labels, page title, subtitle, queue titles, review titles, detail labels, and composer labels accurately and verbatim.
Constraints: label sample state as Demo via banner, sidebar footer, and each board pane; practical shippable UI; no watermark; no browser chrome.
Avoid: average rating, rating summary histogram, trends, sentiment, version, platform, revenue, marketing metrics, KPIs, invented totals, charts, graphs, dashboard statistic cards, gradients, shadows, glass effects, floating cards, oversized decorative typography, extra topbar actions, extra filters, AI writing buttons.
